title: The founder first
direction: A×C · Round 9 · /about · head (88, three lines, one-word accent, stacked) + picture-area plate
summary: The round-9 interior head cast for About — 88px, two lines (“The firm behind / the signature.”), the accent the one word “signature.”, phone floor 44 (38 below 360) — over the picture area: the founder's portrait card, one “A working session” card, and under the portrait “Rameez”, his background line and the way to his letter.
story: The letter on the homepage is signed by a person; this head says so and shows where that person, and the people who join, will be photographed. Nothing is faked: the slots carry no picture until one is taken.

reference.site: ROUND9-PLAN §5 (About), §7.3 (shot cards), kit §12.3–12.4; GoNimbly (picture directly under the headline)
reference.borrowed: GoNimbly's order: headline → short lede → one quiet action → a full-width picture directly beneath, rising and widening on arrival.
reference.kelwin: The picture is honest: until it is shot, each slot is a flat graphite shot card naming the photograph and how it will be taken (no stock people, no generated faces, no silhouettes, no frosted hero crop on this page). A 12-column picture grid (lead 8 cols, two team slots 4 cols) instead of one plate, so the area reads as a set of portraits, not footage.
